entities.name: Markus
entities.description: A human of Kenlefia in Jamuraa sentenced to death at Vacar Slab.

entities.name: Kenlefia
entities.description: A place in Jamuraa whose people mete justice at Vacar Slab.

entities.name: Vacar Slab
entities.description: A place in the middle of the desert where Kenlefians mete justice.

entities.name: Spirokai
entities.description: An Akron Legionnaire who buried Markus up to the neck.

entities.name: Methos
entities.description: Ophelia's brother, who died of thirst near the goal.

entities.name: Teeth
entities.description: The water-bearer who fell off a cliff and returned as a mummy.

entities.name: D'Bray
entities.description: The flagbearer who died of thirst.

entities.name: Cleatin
entities.description: A Gray Ogre protector killed by a Duneclaw.

events.summary: Markus was named The Abuser by the Kenlefians and sentenced to death at Vacar Slab.
events.quote: named Markus "The Abuser" and sentenced him to death at Vacar Slab

events.summary: During the perilous journey the party members died one after another.
events.quote: The journey from Kenlefia to Vacar Slab was perilous, and the party members died sequentially.

events.summary: In a sandstorm Ophelia freed Markus; Spirokai caught them and buried Markus up to the neck.
events.quote: Spirokai caught them though, and buried Markus up to the neck.

events.summary: A zombified Teeth slashed Spirokai in the head and became a mummy.
events.quote: a zombified Teeth showed up and slashed Spirokai in the head with his sword

events.summary: Before dying, Markus told Ophelia his name; Ophelia left alone while Spirokai began to claw his way out.
events.quote: Before dying, the Abuser told Ophelia his name was Markus

relations.note: Spirokai caught her escaping with Markus.
relations.quote: He was about to do the same to Ophelia for betraying him
Ophelia freed Markus and tried to escape
